status: Exploratory plan specified after earlier panel results and metadata review, before the new per-gene/support outcomes. Not preregistered.
question: Is the opposing structural-ECM direction concentrated in one of its fixed genes, and does it persist under stated metadata-only age-support restrictions?
panel_policy: Exactly the existing eight structural-ECM genes with equal weights, all available in both cohorts; no expression-based gene filtering, alias changes, retraining or preferred seven-gene replacement.

populations.all_healthy: All original source-labelled healthy donor codes, 13 cell-resolved and 12 bulk. Disease samples never enter.
populations.shared_observed_age_span: Intersection of the two original healthy age ranges, inclusive; computed from metadata before outcomes. This is 28-61 years, but actual retained bulk ages stop at 45, so ranges are not matched distributions.
populations.shared_nonempty_decade_bins: Keep all donors in floor(age/10)*10 bins containing at least one original healthy donor in each cohort. Frozen bins are 20,30,60. This is only coarse support: 61 versus 63-68 in the older bin is not matched age, and a one-donor bin is retained visibly.

score_modes.fibroblast_only: GSE164241 raw fibroblasts_all CPM, then gene log1p
score_modes.observed_partial_capture: GSE164241 previously audited nine-disjoint-compartment observed partial-mixture CPM, then gene log1p
score_modes.common_RNA_partial_capture: GSE164241 previously frozen 13-healthy-donor common-RNA partial mixture CPM, unchanged, then gene log1p

model_rule: Separate within-source OLS, intercept and centered age in decades; second model adds male plus processing indicator (Cell Ranger3.0.1 versus2.0.0 in GSE164241; batchB versusA in GSE173078). Same donors/design for all eight genes in each fit; full rank and at least two residual degrees of freedom or explicit failure.
contribution_rule: OLS on the mean of the eight gene log1p(CPM) equals the mean of their eight coefficients under identical rows/design. Report every gene coefficient and its 1/8 panel contribution. Absolute contribution shares are descriptive algebra, not causal fractions, independent replication or variance explained.
gene_omission_rule: Compute all eight seven-gene omission diagnostics for every fit. Omission never selects a replacement panel, new weights or a preferred model; genes are not biological replicates.
donor_omission_rule: Omit each donor from each panel fit, keeping population definitions and prior common-RNA weights frozen. This is influence analysis, not donor-held-out validation; omitted cell-source donors contributed to the old common-weight reference.
limits: All population restrictions are demographic sensitivities, not improved clinical validation or age matching.
Bulk, fibroblast-only and partial captured-cell RNA mixtures remain distinct estimands; 386 excluded captured cells have unknown RNA, and capture fractions are not intact tissue fractions.
Source-specific covariates are not a shared batch correction or causal identification; older male coverage remains inadequate.
Relative log1p(CPM), correlated genes and observational donor contrasts cannot establish intrinsic aging, a biological-age estimate, rejuvenation or functional repair.
Matched-donor bulk versus cell-resolved measurements are still missing; cohort, site, ascertainment and assay differences remain unresolved.
